title: TuquetAutomaConfig
description: Configuration schema for Tuquet Automa Workflow Automation Engine (~/.specter/automa/automa.json)

server_host.description: Local HTTP server binding host address

vault_dir.description: Directory storing workflow JSON templates (defaults to ~/.specter/automa/workflows)

sqlite_path.description: Path to local SQLite database (defaults to ~/.specter/automa/automa.sqlite)
